stem: A microbial inoculant produces different outcomes in two otherwise similar trials. What is the most defensible conclusion?
choices: Microbial effects are context dependent, so colonization, environment, substrate, cultivar and measurement quality should be investigated before generalizing
The product must work identically everywhere
The trial with the larger plant proves causation by itself
rationale: Microbe-plant relationships depend on organism identity and context; replication and evidence are needed before attributing an outcome to the inoculant.
